chapter.verse: Tua hi a, hih thute tawh khatlekhat thapiakna na kinei un.
Tu-in sanggamte aw, a hun a phaat tawh kisai-in bang khatpeuh hong kigelh ding na kisam kei uh hi.
A hang pen zan-a ta gutapa bangin Topa' ni hong tung ding cih note mahmah in teltak na thei uh hi.
Mite in, “Nopna lemna leh kepbitna om hi,” a cih laitakun naupaai numei' tungah nausuak natna a tun mah bangin thakhat thu-in tua mite' tungah siatcipna tung ding a, kuamah suakta lo ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, gutapa bangin tua ni in note hong pha vat ahihloh nadingin khuamial sunga om na hikei uh hi.
A hang pen note na vekun khuavak tate, sunkal tate na hi uh hi. Eite zankal tate, khuamial tate i hikei hi.
Tua ahih manin midangte bangin i ihmu kei ding a, pilvang navakin lungsim tei sinsenin i om ding hi.
A hang pen ihmu i cihte zankala ihmu uh hi a, zukham i cihte zankala zukham uh ahi hi.
Eite i hihleh sunkal tawh kisaite i hih nungsang upna leh itna awmdal silhin hotkhiatna tawh kipawl lametna siklukhu khu-in lungsim tei sinsenin i om ding hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh eite pen Pasian in hehna a thuak ding hilo, i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin hotkhiatna a ngah dingin hong seh ahi hi.
Tua Jesu in eite i hing-a i si zongin amah tawh i nuntakkhop theih nadingin eite' taangin sihna thuak hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-a na omdan uh mah bangin khatlekhat kihanthawnin na kiphungvuh un.
Sanggamte aw, note' kiangah nakpi-in na a hong sem mite, Topa' sungah note hong makaihin hong taaibawl mite, na thupisim nadingun kong thum uh hi.
Amaute a sepna uh hangin itna tawh deihphatak na thupibawl un. Nomau' kikal ah nopna lemna omsak un.
Tua ciangin kong hanthotnop uhah, sanggamte aw, thadah zulhtatte taaibawl un. Lungsim thazawmte thapia un. Thanemte dinpih unla vekpi' tungah lungduai un.
Kuamahpeuh a sia pen a sia tawh na kithuhkik loh ding uh kidawm unla khatlekhat' tung leh midangte' tungah a hoih sep sawm den un.
Lungdam den un.
Tatsat lo-in thungen un.
Na khempeuh ah hong hehpihna phat un. Hih pen Khris Jesu' sungah note' ading Pasian' deihna ahi hi.
Kha Siangtho dongtangsak kei un.
Kamsannate neubawl kei unla
thu khempeuh sittelin a hoihte lenkip un.
Thusia kici peuhmah peel un.
Tu-in nopna lemna Pasian mahmah in note a bupin hong siansuah henla i Topa Jesu Khris hong pai hun ah note na kha uh, na nunna kha uh, leh na pumpi uh a bupin a paubaanglo hita hen.
Note hong samkhiapa muanhuai ahih manin tua bangin hong sem ding hi.
Sanggamte aw, kote' ading thu hong ngetsak un.
Sanggamte a vekpi-un siangtho kinapna tawh na hopihsak un.
Sanggamte khempeuh' kiangah hih laikhak na simkhiat nadingun Topa' sungah note kong thum hi.
